visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied in a bun, wearing a blue floral cheongsam (Qipao), stands in front of a large red lantern display. She holds a small glowing red lantern and an oil-paper umbrella. The setting is a wet, urban night street with warm artificial lighting. (2) The woman walks up a steep, narrow stone staircase in an old-style town. Transparent umbrellas are held by her and other figures. Red lanterns hang densely from wooden buildings on both sides. (3) The character interacts with a red-and-gold activity board featuring round slots and red cords. She smiles while looking at the camera. The background shows a wooden temple-like structure with yellow lanterns. (4) Close-up shots show her stamping a colorful card and eating from a white paper bowl with a plastic spoon. The setting transitions between a damp outdoor alley and a brightly lit indoor food stall. (5) She poses inside a large pink Instagram-style prop frame, smiling and holding her small lantern. The background is a stone wall. (6) The final sequence shows her walking down a long, narrow alleyway lit by rows of red lanterns, looking back at the camera before fading to a red screen with text.
